gov_copay_schemes_minutes.name: gov_copay_schemes_minutes
gov_copay_schemes_minutes.value: 0 <= active_from_minute and active_from_minute < active_to_minute and active_to_minute <= 1440

line_message_log_one_push_per_order.name: line_message_log_one_push_per_order
line_message_log_one_push_per_order.where: kind = 'push' and order_id is not null

menu_item_photos_size.name: menu_item_photos_size
menu_item_photos_size.value: byte_size between 1 and 200000 and octet_length(bytes) = byte_size

orders_totals.name: orders_totals
orders_totals.value: subtotal_satang >= 0 and discount_satang >= 0 and discount_satang <= subtotal_satang and total_satang = subtotal_satang - discount_satang

orders_room_delivery_room.name: orders_room_delivery_room
orders_room_delivery_room.value: fulfillment <> 'room_delivery' or room_no is not null

orders_entrance_delivery_recipient.name: orders_entrance_delivery_recipient
orders_entrance_delivery_recipient.value: fulfillment <> 'entrance_delivery' or (delivery_building is not null and btrim(delivery_building) <> '' and recipient_name is not null and btrim(recipient_name) <> '')

payments_cash_change.name: payments_cash_change
payments_cash_change.value: tendered_satang is null or (tendered_satang >= amount_satang and change_satang = tendered_satang - amount_satang)

payments_confirmed_by_staff.name: payments_confirmed_by_staff
payments_confirmed_by_staff.value: status not in ('confirmed', 'voided', 'refunded') or (confirmed_by_staff_id is not null and confirmed_at is not null)
